title: Teachers’ Day Celebrations
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Pioneers, in collaboration with the Rotaract Club of Sydenham College, celebrated Teachers’ Day to honour and appreciate the invaluable contributions of teachers in shaping students’ lives and building the future of society.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Pioneers, in collaboration with the Rotaract Club of Sydenham College, celebrated Teachers’ Day to honour and appreciate the invaluable contributions of teachers in shaping students’ lives and building the future of society.

The initiative aimed to recognise the dedication, guidance and commitment of educators who inspire students to learn, grow and achieve their aspirations. The celebration reflected the shared commitment of Rotary and Rotaract towards education, youth engagement and community development.
